notes.title: Free Skins Update
notes.content:
How does one add a cherry on top of an already FREE game? You make the “special” skins FREE as well! Play The 2020 Trail as a cat, dog, alien, ghost, unicorn, or even a Potatosaurus!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39706193/ec960ac9592ec2432acc0e8122956f5c7b766400_400x225.png

In addition to making all paid skins free, we fixed a few issues:

 Fixed and error causing some events to not dismiss after popping up.
 Corrected several arrow timings for the dance song Trillin'.
 Changed the phrasing for when you die of poor health.
 Players getting stuck on the dance summary screen forcing them to exit by going to the main menu.
 Added letterboxing for non 16:9 aspect ratio screens.


Thanks again for playing The 2020 Trail. We hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Feedback Updates
notes.content:
Based on player feedback, we have made a few small changes to the game:



 Skate Activity - Players have mentioned sometimes not receiving a mood boost for jumping over puddles, so we decreased the hitbox size of puddles to be more forgiving.
 Dance Activity - Some players are having a difficult time with dancing in general, so we doubled the hitbox size of the arrow captures.
 Achievements - Due to the "Trillin'" song being extremely difficult, we changed the "Pro Dancer" achievement to be rewarded for receiving an "Excellent" or higher on all 3 songs.


We appreciate your feedback and thank you for playing The 2020 Trail!

notes.title: Minor fixes and additions
notes.content:
Additions

 Added ability to view credits from the home screen.
 Added exit button to credits scene.

Fixes

 Fixed potential sad face while skating.
 Fixed potential sad face during credits.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
We hope you all enjoying the game! There are a few bugs we corrected:

 Fixed issue where luck events would not close when opening the activity or shop screens. This resulted in players not receiving the outcome of the event.
 Fixed issue where the "resistance to negative news" perk for the Gourmet Popcorn only lasted a week when it should last two.
 Fixed issue where players are unable to get a score higher than "Good" for a skate sesh.

notes.title: The 2020 Trail has a release date
notes.content:
The 2020 Trail is set to release November 22nd, 2021! With the launch right around the corner we've been hard at work to bring you all some thing special. 

Here's what we've been up to since Steam's Summer Next Fest:


 Added a cooking activity that allows you to gain perks and boost your mood. Be sure to keep an eye out for ingredients you need in the store to make something yummy!
 Added a skating activity to help boost your mood. Grind rails, jump puddles, dodge pedestrians and wildlife!
 Added additional calendar weather.
 Added Mac support.
 Added paid skins. If you're feeling fancy, why not time travel as a cat, dog, alien, ghost, unicorn or a cute dino?!
 Added the ability to view the entire calendar year. Look back at all of the events you came across while playing!
 Added an additional store so you can choose where you get your groceries and supplies. Keep an eye out as some stores may carry items that others don't!
 Updated Shopper pathing to be more fluid.
 Added guidance to the game to help you understand what everything is. Pretty much a tutorial.
 And much more! 


We can't wait to share what we created for you all and are looking forward to hearing from you!
